blocks.text: Setting up your Mac for customer onboarding

Your Mac needs to be ready before the client joins. Start by checking your camera and microphone in System Settings. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Camera and ensure Zoom is toggled on. Do the same for Microphone. This prevents the common issue where your video or audio fails to start when a meeting begins.

If you are on an Intel Mac, close memory intensive apps like Chrome with many tabs open. Zoom performs best on Apple Silicon. If you see performance lag, quit unnecessary background processes using Activity Monitor. Press ⌘ + Space, type Activity Monitor, and press Return to open it.

items: ⌘ + ⇧ + V: Start or stop your video.
⌘ + ⇧ + S: Start or stop screen sharing.
⌘ + ⇧ + H: Show or hide the meeting chat.

blocks.text: Memorizing these saves you from searching for buttons while speaking. This keeps your eyes on the camera and the client. You can customize these in Zoom under Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts.

Lazur helps you stay organized while you are in a meeting. Hold ⌥ + ⌘ to ask about a setting or a file. If you need to find a specific document, ask Lazur to look for it. It will not click buttons for you, but it will point out where things are on your screen.

If you are struggling with a complex Zoom setting, ask Lazur to guide you. It will walk you through the steps one click at a time. This is useful when you need to change your virtual background or share sound during a demo.
Handling the sales to CS handover

Info asymmetry is a major challenge for onboarding managers. Use your meeting time to verify data from the CRM. If you use HubSpot or Asana, keep them open in a separate space. Use ⌃ + Right Arrow to switch between your meeting space and your work space.

Never rely on memory. Record every kickoff call. Use the built in recording feature by pressing ⌘ + ⇧ + R. Ensure you have the storage space on your Mac before you start. If you run out of space, change the location in Zoom > Settings > Recording.

items: Not checking internet speed before a high stakes demo.
Forgetting to grant screen recording permissions in System Settings.
Leaving notifications on during a screen share.
Using a low quality microphone that makes audio sound thin.
Failing to update Zoom, leading to compatibility issues.

blocks.text: To avoid notification interruptions, use Focus mode. Click the Control Center icon in the top right of your menu bar, then click Focus. Select Do Not Disturb. This prevents Slack or email alerts from popping up while you present.

faq.question: How do I fix a black screen when sharing in Zoom on Mac?
faq.answer: This is usually a permission issue. Go to System Settings > Privacy & Security > Screen Recording and ensure Zoom is enabled.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons for me in Zoom?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points at buttons and guides you through steps, but you must perform the clicks yourself.

faq.question: What is the best way to improve Zoom performance on an older Mac?
faq.answer: Quit other apps, keep your macOS updated, and avoid using heavy virtual backgrounds. Ensure you are on a wired connection if possible.
